//_area_note: NumBanks=4 (4 KiB), sized as close to a 1000x1000um target as physically achievable. Hard constraint: 4 banks need 16 real SRAM lane-cells (gf180mcu_ocd_ip_sram__sram256x8m8wm1, 301.3x224.93um each, fixed vendor IP size) -- raw cell area alone is ~1.084M sq-um, already ~8% over a 1000x1000 (1.0M sq-um) box with zero margin/routing, so exact 1000x1000 isn't possible at any packing efficiency. 4x4 grid (same proven 350um lane pitch / 280um row pitch as the 2-bank/7-bank/10-bank blocks, one bank per row) is the closest-to-square achievable layout -- narrower grids (2 or 3 lanes/row) reduce width but increase row count enough that height grows faster than width shrinks, moving further from square, not closer. UNVALIDATED -- first real run at this size, expect the usual DRC/PDN iteration.

//_cts_root_buffer_note: PDK default CTS_ROOT_BUFFER (clkbuf_16, 28.000um wide per its LEF SIZE) is exactly as wide as this floorplan's narrowest inter-lane channel (28.56um, bounded by the 10um macro halo on each side of the 48.7um raw gap between adjacent byte-lane macros within a bank) -- confirmed via direct ODB query that DPL-0036 (detailed placement failure in CTS) was caused by exactly this: a clkbuf_16 instance landing with only ~0.56um margin, straddling into a macro's own footprint with no legal site nearby within max_displacement. Dropping to clkbuf_12 (21.280um wide) gives 7.28um of real margin in that same channel.
